title: RunEvent (AIP-58)
description: One envelope in a run's append-only event log — the only interface a UI or supervisor needs (§5 Event log). Types extend the AIP-37 vocabulary.

eventType.description: step.skipped marks a step in an untaken AIP-15 branch arm — terminal, the step never starts in this run; its data carries { reason: "branch-not-taken", branchId }.

seq.description: Monotonic within this run, starting at 1.

stepId.description: Present on every step.* event; absent on run.* events.

data.description: Per-type payload. Shape is informative and host-specific beyond the fields this AIP names elsewhere (e.g. run.failed's data carries the RunError; step.spend's data carries the Spend). Not further constrained here.
